title: South Africa: Pair of mass shootings leave dozens dead
summary: South African police have launched a search for suspects after 17 people were found dead at a tavern southwest of Johannesburg. A separate shooting in Cape Town left 10 dead.

blocks.text: Gunmen armed with assault rifles killed 17 people and wounded 15 others at a bar west of Johannesburg, police said on Sunday.
"They allegedly searched some patrons and took their cellphones before fleeing the scene in two unidentified motor vehicles," the South African ​Police Service ‌said.
Emergency ‌services ‌declared all ​17 victims dead at the scene. Authorities said the shooting occurred Saturday at around 9:30 p.m. local time (1930 UTC).
A motive for the shooting ⁠was ​not ​known, the South African ​Police Service ‌said, adding that "suspects ​were reportedly ⁠armed with AK-47 rifles ⁠and ​pistols."

In a separate shooting in Cape Town, police said gunmen killed 10 people and wounded 11 more at an entertainment venue in Lwandle at 1:46 a.m. (2346 Saturday GMT). Authorities said five of the victims died at the scene.
This article will be updated as more details become available.
